repositories.name: redis
repositories.description: For developers, who are building real-time data-driven applications, Redis is the preferred, fastest, and most feature-rich cache, data structure server, and document and vector query engine.

repositories.name: valkey
repositories.description: A flexible distributed key-value database that is optimized for caching and other realtime workloads.

repositories.name: dragonfly
repositories.description: A modern replacement for Redis and Memcached

repositories.name: garnet
repositories.description: Garnet is a remote cache-store from Microsoft Research that offers strong performance (throughput and latency), scalability, storage, recovery, cluster sharding, key migration, and replication features. Garnet can work with existing Redis clients.
